stock.description: New Amante Group Limited functions as an investment firm with primary interests spanning the club, entertainment, and restaurant sectors. Its operational structure is divided into two distinct segments: the direct management of club and entertainment ventures, and strategic securities investment. The company was established by Shing Joe Ng on May 19, 2016, and maintains its corporate headquarters in Hong Kong.
